records.name: Focus Flash
records.acquisition: Expert Mission 18 — The Ultimate Evil: Broly
records.evidence: Current repository skill indexing identifies Focus Flash as a 100-Ki Ki Blast Super acquired from Expert Mission 18. The EM18 evidence layer independently identifies Focus Flash as the mission skill reward, while the endpoint audit links skill-focus-flash to expert-mission-18. Official Bandai Namco update provenance is retained for the skill's update-era introduction.
records.mechanics: Current dedicated evidence describes an initial large Ki Blast followed by a rapid smaller-blast volley when the initial sphere connects; it can also be used during Boost Dash.
limits: Exact per-clear reward-generation/drop probability remains unresolved.
No additional prerequisite or Ultimate Finish-only gate is inferred.
Exact frame data, stacking behavior, and version-independent damage are not promoted.

records.name: Data Input
records.evidence: Current repository skill indexing identifies Data Input as a 100-Ki Power Up Super acquired from EM20 as a Basic Reward. The EM18-20 evidence layer independently identifies Data Input with EM20 and documents its self-buff behavior. Repository provenance preserves the distinction between the free-update EM20 acquisition and Extra Pack 1's paid DLC content.
records.mechanics: Current dedicated evidence describes approximately 20 seconds of automatic dodging against basic melee attacks while the buff remains active.
limits: Exact per-clear reward-generation/drop probability remains unresolved.
No Ultimate Finish-only gate is inferred.
The Android 13 preset association does not change the EM20 acquisition endpoint.
Exact timing edge cases, invulnerability coverage, frame data, and version-independent damage are not promoted.

evidence_boundary: This batch reconciles the EM18-20 skill endpoints using current Xenoverse 2-specific repository evidence, dedicated skill documentation, endpoint/cross-domain audits, and official update/DLC provenance where applicable. It deliberately does not infer numerical drop rates, hidden reward conditions, frame data, or unsupported acquisition gates. Raid-tagged rewards such as Gigantic Ki Blast and Peeler Storm remain separate from the ordinary skill acquisition endpoints.
